answer_1.quote: we propose the first extractive summarization-based collaborative filtering model, ESCOFILT ... our novel model generates extractive summaries that bear more resemblance to real-life explanations
answer_1.outputs: extractive summary explanations for items and users

answer_4.quote: We generated a total of 90 item explanations... For pointwise evaluation, we asked two human judges to assess the explanations based on our proposed real-life explainability criteria on a five-point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Assess explanations using a five-point Likert scale according to criteria such as Coherence, Completeness, Lack of Alternatives, Novelty, Perceived Truth, Quality, and Visualization; also perform listwise ranking of explanation helpfulness.
